scope: SOURCE ONLY: private original-Half Vision TP8 adapter for the 27 Qwen3-VL vision blocks (attention + MLP). Not compiled, not launched, not measured by its author; the root agent owns every hardware receipt.

backend_contract.prime: prime(name, weight_half, bias_half_or_None, mode, m=8064) -> entry
backend_contract.run: run(entry, activation_half_2d) -> Half (m,n) in column mode or Float32 (m,n) row partial in row mode
backend_contract.snapshot: snapshot() -> data (recorded as an opaque backend receipt)

api.attention_contract: standalone callable (q, k, v) -> Half 4D, called once per image segment with strict shape (1, 2, 4032, 72); it owns the original 72 ** -0.5 scale and is never installed as a global helper

patch_surface.mechanism: instance attribute only (types.MethodType), never a class-level patch
patch_surface.conflict_note: VisionBiasAdapter87 patches the Linear CLASS; this adapter bypasses the 108 block linears while enabled and leaves the 8 merger linears to that existing adapter

geometry.channel_coverage: 4304 = 8*538 and 1152 = 8*144 tile exactly; no gap or overlap

dtype_contract.column_mode_output: Half after Float32 accumulation + exact Half bias widened to Float32
dtype_contract.row_mode_output: Float32 partial with NO bias; collective in Float32; then full original bias widened to Float32; then exactly one Half cast
dtype_contract.module_boundary_output: Half (m, 1152), so the next LayerNorm sees the same dtype
dtype_contract.activation_into_gelu: Half (m, 538): the original nn.GELU(approximate="tanh") runs only on real logical channels, never on Cube padding

memory.note: the adapter hands each Half slice to backend.prime() and drops its own reference; any retained packing is the backend's, reported there

root_must_verify_on_hardware: Cube support for m=8064 with the four (k,n) shapes and the 128-padded k/n
column mode really accumulates in Float32 over the original Half input/weight and applies the exact Half bias widened to Float32 before one Half cast
row mode really returns a Float32 partial (a Half partial must fail closed here)
all_reduce stays Float32 and returns the same shape
the 2-head local attention callable returns Half (1,2,4032,72) per image segment
the backend pads k/n to k_pad/n_pad and returns only the logical n columns
cu_seqlens is [0,4032,8064] for the two benchmark images
enabled forward reproduces 27 attention + 27 MLP calls, 54 collectives, 108 primed linear weights and 54 local attention invocations
disable restores the native full-16-head baseline bit-for-bit

no_actual_claim.why: Float32 HCCL partials can change low bits and fewer local heads change the attention grouping; only the root real graph against the original CPU FP16 reference can accept or reject this path
